Bomb It / Q版泡泡堂初代

Source distribution: 4399, pinned game.swf URL and digest in source-manifest.json.
The original game's artwork, music, sound, characters and rules remain the
property of their respective original authors and rights holders. A downloadable
SWF is not a grant of an open-source or redistribution license. No new license
for those materials is asserted by this integration.

Integration changes: removal of the unused FWAd_AS2 advertising/news framework
and its symbol registrations, clearing FileAttributes.UseNetwork, plus a separate
mobile host adapter. Original gameplay, AI, visual and sound tag bytes are retained.

The standalone site loader, score-upload wrapper and remote News.swf are not
distributed in the production payload. Original local high scores are preserved.

Ruffle v0.7.1 is a separate Flash runtime distributed under the upstream choice
of MIT or Apache-2.0 license. Both original license files are included in
ThirdParty/Ruffle and in the packaged ruffle/ directory. Their terms do not
relicense the game content.
